name: better-world-clock
title: Better World Clock
description: See the current time in your favorite cities and time zones.
author: madeyexz

commands.name: index
commands.title: World Clock
commands.description: Show favorite world clock time zones.

preferences.name: timeZones
preferences.title: Time Zones
preferences.description: Type city names separated by commas, for example: San Francisco, New York, London, Tokyo. Advanced: IANA IDs like Europe/London also work.
preferences.placeholder: San Francisco, New York, London, Tokyo
preferences.default: San Francisco, New York, London, Tokyo

preferences.name: viewMode
preferences.title: View
preferences.description: Choose whether World Clock opens as a visual grid or compact list.

preferences.name: clockStyle
preferences.title: Clock Style
preferences.description: Choose digital or analog clock cards in grid view.

preferences.name: use24HourTime
preferences.title: Use 24-Hour Time
preferences.label: Display times in 24-hour format
preferences.description: Display times in 24-hour format instead of AM/PM.
